profile.headline: Principal Member of Technical Staff at AMD
profile.summary:
*Hardware Emulation*

Owner and developer of perl based emulation buildtime/runtime infrastructure for AMD.  Palladium 'expert user' with focus on creating tools/flows to increase users effectiveness on the emulator.  Created TCL based QEL Monitor API Methodology to dramatically improve debug and automation capabilities for emulation users.

*Verification*

Broad level of experience verifying components of a microprocessor from the CPU core at Sun Microsystems to power management components in the NB and Hypertransport logic at AMD.  This includes creating stimulus, monitors and checkers using multiple methodologies including VMM.

Familiar with VPI and other interfaces for communications between the Verilog simulator and C++.  Created VPI application at Sun for DFT related static connectivity checks.

*Infrastructure*

Very knowledgeable on most aspects of AMD global verification infrastructure.  I've significantly streamlined many of the flows and have created numerous perl scripts to automate common tasks.  Tied together our web based regression system with bugzilla as part of the CNB group making bug creation and assignment almost push-button.
 
The AMD/ATI merger brought two drastically different verification environments together.  I was one of the first to learn about and work in the SystemC based ATI environment and have been involved in driving integration between the two environments - specifically in areas related to hardware emulation.

I love writing Perl and creating flows that help RTL or other verification engineers work faster and more effectively.

*Methodology*

One of the first to investigate and create a VMM based test environment for evaluation and then later implementation.  Work as a part of the Verification Testbench COE which provides global methodology recommendations and led the implementation of a few of these efforts.  Primarly owner and developer of methodlogies related to hardware emulation.

Specialties: Software: Perl, UNIX/Linux, Verilog, TCL, C/C++, Shell Scripting, VPI/PLI, MySQL, VMM, Java, Ruby, CGI, HTML, Assembly

VC Systems: CVS, Subversion, Perforce, Clearcase

Tools: Palladium. VCS, NCVerilog, Verdi, Oin, OVL, Fastscan
Chrysalis

Methodologies: Emulation, Coverage, Assertions, Integration, Formal Verification, Infrastructure Development, Software Development, Process Improvements, Verification Environment Development

positions.title: Verification/Software Engineer
positions.description:
As part of the Emulation Center of Excellence (ECOE), owner and developer of the Perl-based hardware emulation buildtime/runtime infrastructure for AMD.  Developed TCL-based QEL Monitor methodology for the Palladium emulator to enable next-level debug visibility and automation capabilities for the Platform team.  Support internal and external emulation customers across the globe as Palladium "expert user."   Develop a number of tools, methodologies and flows around emulator utilization, LSF and random test development (AMEX) to realize significant emulation efficiency improvements.  As integration leader, received Executive Spotlight Award for completion of a stretch goal that allowed concurrent platform level emulation testing of a CPU and GPU for the first time.  Led evaluation of the new Palladium PXP technology.

As a member of the Core North Bridge (CNB) group, developed a comprehensive regression tracking system using Perl, CGI, MySQL and HTML, which provided up-to-the minute status on test regression runs.  Additionally, failure modes were analyzed in real-time and matched up with existing filed bugs, and methods were in place to automatically rerun failures with unrecognized signatures.  Developed and supported coverage flow.  Owned a number of power management related test-plan items and wrote tests, VMM based monitors and checkers, coverage points and assertions.  Responsible for a fair amount of R&D work analyzing new technologies such as SystemVerilog, VMM, OVM to provide future direction for AMD.

Primary developer and maintainer of verification environments which supported Hypertransport and PCIE testing.  Mentored new employees, participated in test-plan creation, worked with RTL designers, wrote tests and debugged failures.

positions.title: Verification/Software Engineer
positions.description:
Created and supported a Perl random generator "FOCUS" which was chosen by the Niagra2 (N2) project as the random assembly generator of choice.  N2 highlighted the tool as "What Is Cool" in the PNP Verification Summit. Co-creator of Millennium (MM) bug distribution concept implemented as "Dilbert". This flow was used across the whole project to track failures and automatically run regressions as the codeline advanced. Created tools for debug support including irupath (an IRU debug tool widely used), mm_memdump (PLI memory dumper and viewer), and mmupath.  Also designed bug triage tool used in Dilbert flow.

Revised and supported the coverage flow for MM.  Introduced methodology to automatically translate architect-driven coverage rules into verification coverage matrices.  This eliminated wasted time due to communication issues. 

Filed 585 Metrax issues in bug-hunting phase all over the chip through simulation, formal analysis, SAT work, and static network analysis.  Verified DFT methodology rules by implementing a VPI static network analyzer in C++.  Found approximately 30-40 bugs late in the project.  Responsible for testing all the decode logic in the renaming unit, as well as the "helper" generation logic. Created testplans, wrote assembly tests, supported monitors and used FOCUS to inject random elements to what would otherwise have been static tests of nominal use.

positions.title: Co-Op Engineer
positions.description: Owned chipset code conversion project.  Converted x86 assembly programs to run on Intel's latest chipset, Camino (i820). Wrote plans to test Camino's Y2K and GPIO features. Scheduled and assisted other engineers with setting up the Quickturn simulation environment.

positions.title: Co-Op Engineer
positions.description: Conducted SPEC testing on IBM AIXIOP.  Assisted clients with GIS setup and applications on AS/400 and prototype network stations. Worked with software team to write an interface tool between Domino's N&A book and AS/400's SDD.
